definition_context.SpatialPeriodic: ∀ (x : Vec) (i : Fin 3), f (x + EuclideanSpace.single i 1) = f x
definition_context.unitCube: {x | ∀ i : Fin 3, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1}
definition_context.datumFourierCoeff: fun k i => ∫ x in unitCube, star (fourierCharacter k x) * (a x i : ℂ)
definition_context.fourierCharacter: Complex.exp ((((2 * Real.pi * (∑ i : Fin 3, (k i : ℝ) * x i)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
definition_context.derivativeSymbol: ((2 * Real.pi * (k j : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
definition_context.spectralMultiplier: fun k i => m k * a k i
definition_context.RapidScalarFourier: ∀ m : ℕ, Summable (fun k => ‖b k‖ * ‖fourierPhaseCLM k‖ ^ m)
definition_context.scalarFourierSeries: fun x => ∑' k : Frequency, fourierCharacter k x * b k
definition_context.smoothFourierSynthesis: fun x => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin 3 => (scalarFourierSeries (fun k => c k i) x).re)
definition_context.SpectralReality: ∀ k i, c (-k) i = star (c k i)
definition_context.coefficientLeray: if k = 0 then v else fun i => v i - (k i : ℂ) * (∑ j : Fin 3, (k j : ℂ) * v j) / (∑ j : Fin 3, (k j : ℂ) ^ 2)
definition_context.fourierDecayConstant: ∑ i : Fin 3, ((∫ x in unitCube, ‖a x i‖) + ∑ j : Fin 3, coordinateDerivativeL1 j m a i)
definition_context.coordinateDerivativeL1: ∫ x in unitCube, ‖iteratedCoordinateDerivative j m a x i‖
